description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of the rough bark of a colossal tree trunk: deep furrows in dark brown bark, small patches of moss, a few drops of golden resin, muted very dark palette of bark brown, dark olive and dim amber, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
